hook_text: Mpho's mother was born on 29 February. So is she thirty-six, or only nine?
clip_script: Thohoyandou netball court. A learner in a yellow cap is the Sun. Mpho carries the Earth around the circle: that's revolution. One lap is a year, 365 and a quarter days! Four quarters make a whole day, so every four years we add 29 February. Leap year! Now add Mercury: a tiny lap, 88 days. Neptune? One lap takes 165 years. No birthdays there at all!
visual_style: Whiteboard netball court with a Sun in the centre and planets running around circles of different sizes.
mood: Fun and surprising, built around a birthday puzzle.
pacing: Puzzle, one slow lap, then quick laps for other planets.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out how many times you have travelled around the Sun.
